# PLAN — iteration 3
## Current state assessment
Iterations 1 and 2 preserved behavior and passed simulation and timing closure, but both were rejected because the candidate matched the incumbent at 4 LUTs and 5 FFs. The incumbent is already timing-feasible, so promotion requires strictly fewer LUTs, or equal LUTs with fewer FFs. The current seed is a transparent wrapper around the frozen child; the top requires `// @latency 0`.

## Hypothesis
Replacing the counter and candidate tracking with a seven-sample history may reduce LUT use by checking whether the previous seven samples match the current input, at the cost of three additional FFs.

## Instruction for generator
In `debouncer_top`, replace the child instance with a 7-bit history register and registered `clean`; synchronously clear both on active-high `rst`, shift in `noisy` each other rising edge, and update `clean` when all seven prior history bits equal the current `noisy` value. This must change `clean` on the eighth consecutive sample, preserve reset and registered-output behavior, and retain `// @latency 0`. Target fewer than 4 routed LUTs; keep the candidate only if it passes every gate and beats the timing-feasible incumbent under the strict LUT/FF objective.
